name: Rafael Silva
bio:
Rafael's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in São Paulo, captivated by the roar of engines at Interlagos. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. His early career involved stints at local racing teams, honing his skills in data analysis and vehicle setup. He quickly gained a reputation for his meticulous approach and problem-solving abilities, leading to his appointment as a junior engineer at Blau Motorsport. 

Over the years, Rafael rose through the ranks, demonstrating a knack for identifying areas for improvement and optimizing performance. He thrives under pressure, often working late into the night to ensure the cars are perfectly prepared. His strengths lie in his ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights for the drivers and mechanics. He’s known for his creative solutions and isn’t afraid to challenge conventional wisdom. 

Rafael is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of engineering excellence, constantly seeking innovative ways to extract every last ounce of performance from the car. His leadership style is hands-on; he believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. He is dedicated to leading Blau Motorsport to the forefront of competitive racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Rafael is a man of medium height with a focused gaze and a wiry build, often seen with grease smudges on his hands.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking a specific brand of Brazilian coffee before every race.
